tc01.steps:
Initial Environment

    configure DUT1
    X0:192.168.1.1
    X1:WAN DHCP mode
    X2:192.168.56.1

    configure DUT1
    X0:192.168.2.1
    X1:WAN DHCP mode
    X2:192.168.50.1

    1.establish unnumbered vpn between DUT1 and DUT2,named BGP1 and BGP2
    2.enable BGP and configured from CLI from DUT1
    router bgp 56
    neighbor 192.168.50.1 remote-as 56
    neighbor 192.168.50.1 update-source 192.168.56.1
    3.add static route on DUT1,to 192.158.50.1 from tunnel BGP1
    4.enable BGP and configured from CLI from DUT2
    router bgp 56
    neighbor 192.168.56.1 remote-as 56
    neighbor 192.168.56.1 update-source 192.168.50.1
    5.add static route on DUT1,to 192.198.56.1 from tunnel BGP2
    6.check if IBGP neighbor can be established
tc01.title: IBGP over unnumbered VPN can established
tc01.result: IBGP over unnumbered VPN can established

tc08.steps:
Initial Environment

    configure DUT1
    X0:192.168.1.1
    X1:WAN DHCP mode
    X2:192.168.56.1

    configure DUT1

    X2:192.168.50.1

    router bgp 56
    neighbor 192.168.50.1 remote-as 56
    neighbor 192.168.50.1 update-source 192.168.56.1
    3.add static route on DUT1,to 192.158.50.1 from tunnel BGP1

    5.add static route on DUT1,to 192.198.56.1 from tunnel BGP2

    7.add related ACL,and ping from a PC on X0 subnet of  DUT1 to a PC on X0 subnet of DUT2.

tc08.result: Verify the traffic between DUT and the network prefix advertised by BGP over unnumbered interface
